description: List the UK local authorities (councils) covered by the GeraEats food-hygiene dataset, optionally filtered by a name fragment (e.g. "london", "york", "glasgow"). Use this first to find the exact authority name/slug to pass to the other tools. Returns each authority's slug, name, rating scheme (FHRS for England/Wales/NI, FHIS for Scotland) and establishment count.

contains.description: Optional case-insensitive name fragment to filter authorities, e.g. "shire" or "city".

name: list_authorities
title: List UK local authorities with hygiene data
